extDescription.message: Rewrite text in any field into three clearer alternatives using your own LLM key.

error_not_configured.message: Choose a provider and model in Corretto settings.

error_no_key.message: Add your API key in Corretto settings to start.

error_permission.message: Corretto needs permission to contact your provider. Open settings and save again.

error_invalid_key.message: Your API key was rejected. Check it in settings.

error_model_not_found.message: The model was not found. Check the model name in settings.

error_rate_limited.message: The provider's rate limit was reached. Wait a moment, then retry.

error_timeout.message: The provider took too long to answer.

error_network.message: Couldn't reach the provider. Check your connection or the server address.

error_bad_output.message: The model's answer couldn't be read. Retry, or try another model.

error_too_long.message: This text is too long (max 5,000 characters). Select a shorter part.

error_http.message: The provider returned an error. Please retry.

error_unknown.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

options_lead.message: Choose an AI provider and paste your own API key. Several providers have a free tier.

options_baseUrlHint.message: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API, ending before /chat/completions.

options_modelHint.message: Leave as suggested unless you know which model you want.

options_permissionDenied.message: Permission was not granted, so Corretto can't contact this provider.

options_privacy.message: Your key stays in this browser (it is not synced) and is sent only to the provider you choose. Corretto has no server and collects no data.

error_changed.message: The text changed while Corretto was working. Try again.
